events.name: Nebraska Cornhuskers at Illinois Fighting Illini

headlines.description: — Collin Dixon caught two touchdown passes including a record-breaker and Illinois used a trick play to set up its go-ahead TD as the Illini defeated Nebraska 24-13 on Friday night to become bowl eligible with their fourth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Collin Dixon's 2 TD catches help Illinois become bowl eligible with 24-13 victory over Nebraska

events.name: New Mexico Lobos at Nevada Wolf Pack

headlines.description: — New Mexico coach Jason Eck admitted the No. 22 Lobos' 31-3 victory over Nevada and coach Jeff Choate felt extra sweet.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 22 New Mexico wins in first game in AP poll in school history, beating Nevada 31-3
